liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (5 reviews): China Cat into Rider closing the first set was a surprise to the reviewer; this copy sounds excellent; China into Rider as first-set closer sparkled [12][14][15][17][20]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Singled out as an excellent version in the first set [13]
- **The Race Is On** (1 review): Singled out as excellent, alongside They Love Each Other [13]
- **Playin' In The Band Jam** (1 review): Playin' into Eyes of the World in the second set works well; Brent's keyboards are all over it [18]
- **I Will Take You Home** (1 review): Reviewer says they could do without this song, though the show is top notch [18]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Not Fade Away huge [16]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer found Peggy-O sweet, leading through They Love Each Other, The Race Is On and Queen Jane [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-05-06.142355.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk2.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 28 songs; 177 min [1]
- **gd89-05-06.sbd.nawrocki.14262.sbefixed.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 166 min; rated 4.58/5 by 12 [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has crisp highs and deep lows; Brent is prominent and playing strongly [15]
- **gd1989-05-06.sbd.nawrocki.tetzeli.fix-14262.34769.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 167 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd89-05-06.dsbd.serifin.5423.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 26 songs; 166 min; rated 4.04/5 by 23 [8]. Said about its sound: Soundboard from this run is called a reference standard for sound quality and dynamics, great played loud on a high-end stereo; Sound quality is so good that no EQ adjustment is needed on the reviewer's iPod [11][14]

## Around the show

- Reviewer got the tape that week, which was Derby weekend; they weren't at the show [12]
- Lovely day at the Frost; relaxed, family-like crowd of old friends, feeling like a big backyard party [13]
- Reviewer, aged 16, couldn't get in; the parking lot raged with vehicles blasting the radio broadcast across the lot [14]
- Reviewer suggests the Race Is On fits because the show fell on Derby day [18]
- Reviewer recommends also downloading the next night, 5-7-89, as another show with amazing setlists [22]
- Reviewer says Frost shows are always a good download [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-05-06.142355.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk2.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB) Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK2 mics > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Master Dat (Sony… [1]
- **gd89-05-06.sbd.nawrocki.14262.sbefixed.shnf**: source: shntool fixed shns of Jay Serafin dsbd seed [4]
- **gd1989-05-06.sbd.nawrocki.tetzeli.fix-14262.34769.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 14262 [5]. Also: Seamless transition made between CDs 2 and 3, with errors fixed using shntool and fade tracks added [5]
- **gd89-05-06.dsbd.serifin.5423.sbefail.shnf**: source: DSBD [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1989-05-07 Frost Amphitheatre, Palo Alto, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-05-07-frost-amphitheatre-palo-alto-ca-usa/) [27]
